cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

project(luisa_metal4_ios_path_tracer LANGUAGES CXX OBJCXX)

if (NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "iOS")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
            "This project must be configured for iOS "
            "(-DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME=iOS -DCMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT=iphoneos).")
endif ()

set(LUISA_METAL_CPP_DIR "" CACHE PATH
        "Path to the metal-cpp release root (the directory containing Metal/Metal.hpp)")
set(LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_METALLIB "" CACHE FILEPATH
        "Path to the iOS AIR metallib generated by luisa-metal4-ios-path-tracer-aot")
set(LUISA_IOS_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM "" CACHE STRING
        "Apple development team used for automatic signing")
set(LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACING_SPP 8 CACHE STRING
        "Samples per pixel rendered by the device smoke test")

if (NOT EXISTS "${LUISA_METAL_CPP_DIR}/Metal/Metal.hpp")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
            "LUISA_METAL_CPP_DIR does not point to a metal-cpp release: "
            "'${LUISA_METAL_CPP_DIR}'.")
endif ()
if (NOT EXISTS "${LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_METALLIB}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
            "LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_METALLIB does not exist: "
            "'${LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_METALLIB}'.")
endif ()
get_filename_component(LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_METALLIB_NAME
        "${LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_METALLIB}" NAME)
if (NOT LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_METALLIB_NAME STREQUAL
        "luisa_ios_path_tracing.metallib")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
            "The device runner expects the bundled AIR library to be named "
            "'luisa_ios_path_tracing.metallib'.")
endif ()

file(SHA256 "${LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_METALLIB}"
        LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_AIR_SHA256)

add_executable(luisa-metal4-ios-path-tracer MACOSX_BUNDLE
        main.mm
        metal_cpp_impl.cpp
        "${LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_METALLIB}")

set_source_files_properties(
        "${LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_METALLIB}"
        PROPERTIES
        MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION Resources
        HEADER_FILE_ONLY TRUE)

target_compile_features(luisa-metal4-ios-path-tracer PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(luisa-metal4-ios-path-tracer PRIVATE -fblocks)
target_include_directories(luisa-metal4-ios-path-tracer PRIVATE
        "${LUISA_METAL_CPP_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(luisa-metal4-ios-path-tracer PRIVATE
        LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACING_SPP=${LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACING_SPP}
        LUISA_IOS_AIR_SHA256="${LUISA_IOS_PATH_TRACER_AIR_SHA256}")
target_link_libraries(luisa-metal4-ios-path-tracer PRIVATE
        "-framework Foundation"
        "-framework UIKit"
        "-framework Metal"
        "-framework CoreGraphics"
        "-framework ImageIO")

set_target_properties(luisa-metal4-ios-path-tracer PROPERTIES
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Info.plist.in"
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_NAME "Luisa Metal4 Path Tracer"
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER "org.luisa-compute.metal4-path-tracer"
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_VERSION "1"
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_SHORT_VERSION_STRING "1.0"
        XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME TRUE
        XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER
        "org.luisa-compute.metal4-path-tracer"
        XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_CODE_SIGN_STYLE Automatic
        XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "26.0"
        XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY "1"
        XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS "iphoneos"
        XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_SUPPORTS_MACCATALYST NO
        XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_ENABLE_BITCODE NO)

if (LUISA_IOS_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM)
    set_target_properties(luisa-metal4-ios-path-tracer PROPERTIES
            XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM
            "${LUISA_IOS_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM}")
endif ()
